mentioned.quote: Cybersecurity: Risks of models assisting in the execution of a cyber attack.

threshold.quote: Capable of fully automating opportunistic cyberattacks on organizations with a limited security posture.
threshold.note: Cyber autonomy level 1 CCL; also Cyber enablement level 1.

response.quote: If this happens, we would put on hold further deployment or development, or implement additional protocols (such as the implementation of more precise early warning evaluations for a given CCL) to ensure models will not reach CCLs without appropriate security mitigations, and that models with CCLs will not be deployed without appropriate deployment mitigations.
response.note: Binding 'would' in if-then (p.2): hold deployment/development so models with CCLs are not deployed without deployment mitigations; mitigation levels defined in tables pp.3-4. Applies framework-wide to every CCL (A9).

acc_decider.note: No named role or body decides anywhere in the document; acknowledgements p.7 list authors only.

acc_external.note: p.6 'We will also explore how to appropriately involve independent third parties' is hedged (explore, appropriately); p.1 'Where appropriate, involve external parties' describes RCS principles, hedged.

acc_unmet.quote: If this happens, we would put on hold further deployment or development, or implement additional protocols (such as the implementation of more precise early warning evaluations for a given CCL) to ensure models will not reach CCLs without appropriate security mitigations, and that models with CCLs will not be deployed without appropriate deployment mitigations.
acc_unmet.note: Condition is mitigations at the required levels not being ready (p.2 'A model may reach evaluation thresholds before mitigations at appropriate levels are ready'); response is to put deployment/development on hold.
